prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Katy, Texas, and has wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1156; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This call is being recorded for the claim file. Can you please state your full name for the record?

A: Yes, go ahead and note that I'm the driver of the vehicle involved in the collision.

Q: Understood. Can you walk me through where and when the collision happened?

A: It was in a parking lot near a shopping center in Katy, Texas. I was pulling out of a parking space in the row near the main entrance, and I was going very slowly, maybe five miles an hour.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before contact?

A: Not right away. I had checked my mirror, but a white sedan came down the lane from my right side pretty quickly. I braked, but we still made contact on my front passenger corner.

Q: Were you injured?

A: Yes. I put my left hand out on the steering wheel when I stopped, and I felt a sharp pain in my wrist. I went to urgent care later that afternoon and they took X-rays. The doctor told me it's a fracture, and I've got a splint and I'm supposed to see a hand specialist.

Q: Did you call for medical assistance at the scene?

A: No, I didn't think it was serious at first. I was shaken up but I could still drive, so I drove myself home and got it checked later.

Q: Did anyone else witness the collision?

A: I didn't see anyone standing nearby. There may have been people inside the store, but I can't say for sure.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything else you'd like to add about the incident?

A: Just that I have photos of both vehicles on my phone, and I can send them to you. I'd like to get this resolved so I can get back to work.

Q: We'll follow up on that. Thank you for your time today.
